name: GlobalFoundries gf180mcu 5V FD 7-track (gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0)

cap_options.name: sm141064_mim
cap_options.notes: model deck present as libs.tech/ngspice/sm141064_mim.spice; density/Pelgrom still estimates

ramp.notes: single-slope ramp: step-to-step linearity and the ramp-buffer settling are estimates; the clock ceiling is the profile's digital ceiling. There is no cap array, so DNL comes from the ramp, not from Pelgrom mismatch.

sdm.notes: second-order 1-bit switched-cap loop. loading_db is the measured gap between the linearized NTF bound and the L1 bitstream simulation at 0.5 FS (9.0 dB, flat over OSR 16..64); it is not a stability margin estimate. Integrator GBW is an estimate. The decimator does not exist, so the reported ENOB assumes an ideal one.

measurement.note: no ring-DCO measurement exists for the 5 V seven-track process; 12 MHz f_max and the 2.7x range ratio are assumptions anchored on the sibling 3.3 V ring (21.07 MHz at 3.3 V).
measurement.curvature_pct_basis: assumption: 4k x(1-x) tuning deviation fitted to nothing; flagged as unverified

digital_ceiling_source: adpll_gen pdk_profiles.json gf180mcu_fd5 signoff_mhz (post-route SPEF; 50 MHz SS not closed)
maturity: ciel-managed 5V library; digital ceiling is low, expect a slow ADC clock

analog.notes: device names read from the installed gf180mcuD ngspice deck (sm141064.spice): .subckt nfet_05v0/pfet_05v0, nf finger param, SI w/l. Simulate with design.spice included first and `.lib sm141064.spice <corner>` from the deck directory.

opamp.notes: shared OTA block (E2). gain/GBW are placeholders; the OTA leaf does not exist in this repo.

flash.notes: ladder unit area is the dac-generator poly unit; encoder delay is a placeholder. sigma_is_random is false because no profile has a measured random comparator offset distribution.

resistors.name: poly_unit
resistors.notes: dac-generator/analog/string unit; no sign-off resistor layout, Pelgrom and voltage coefficient are placeholders.

dual_slope.notes: A0 and offset are OTA placeholders; dielectric absorption is unmeasured on every PDK and is the decisive 12 b number.

ti.notes: offset inherits the comparator sigma; there is no N-phase clock and no measured layout skew.
